title: Storybound migrations
description: config/storybound/migrations/<path>.json — ids renamed since players' saves were made, old to new. Saved progress (flags, quests, pins, rewards, the Journal, the Codex, bosses, added waypoints, 'once' marks) moves to the new ids when the server starts, after /reload and when a player joins. A rename is ignored while the old id is still defined. Keep the files for as long as old saves may exist.

flags.description: Flags and variables, in every scope.

quests.description: Quests: progress in every scope, pins, rewards waiting to be claimed.

dialogues.description: Dialogues: options marked 'once', dialogues bound to an entity with /storybound npc.

documents.description: Documents: read marks, the Journal's archive, document items in players' inventories.

codex.description: Codex entries: open sections and counters.

stages.description: Stages inside a quest, named by the quest's new id: { "mypack:hunt": { "old": "new" } }. The current stage and the quest's log.

objectives.description: Objective ids inside a quest, named by the quest's new id; their counters move.

codex_sections.description: Section ids inside a Codex entry, named by the entry's new id; players' open sections move.
